functions.name: guess_type
functions.done: Guesses the MIME type from a file name.

proof.r:
library(mime)
x <- list(
  basic=guess_type(c('a/b/c.html','d.pdf','e.odt','foo.docx','tex')),
  extra=guess_type(c('a.md','b.R')),
  override=guess_type('tex', mime_extra=c(tex='text/plain')),
  unknown=guess_type('foo.zzz'),
  empty=guess_type('Makefile'),
  subtype=guess_type(c('abc.html','def.htm'), subtype=c('charset=UTF-8',''))
)
print(x)
proof.python:
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).parents[1]))
from mime.api import guess_type
x = dict(basic=guess_type(['a/b/c.html','d.pdf','e.odt','foo.docx','tex']),
         extra=guess_type(['a.md','b.R']),
         override=guess_type('tex', mime_extra={'tex':'text/plain'}),
         unknown=guess_type('foo.zzz'), empty=guess_type('Makefile'),
         subtype=guess_type(['abc.html','def.htm'], subtype=['charset=UTF-8','']))
print(x)

proof.r:
library(mime)
raw <- charToRaw(paste0('--x\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="a"\r\n\r\none\r\n--x\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename="a.txt"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\nhello\r\n--x--\r\n'))
pos <- 1L
inp <- new.env()
inp$read <- function(n) { z <- raw[pos:min(length(raw),pos+n-1L)]; pos <<- pos+length(z); z }
inp$rewind <- function() pos <<- 1L
env <- list(CONTENT_TYPE='multipart/form-data; boundary=x', CONTENT_LENGTH=length(raw), rook.input=inp)
z <- parse_multipart(env)
z$f$datapath <- 'FILE'
print(z)
proof.python:
import io, sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).parents[1]))
from mime.api import parse_multipart
class I(io.BytesIO):
    def rewind(self): self.seek(0)
body=(b'--x\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="a"\r\n\r\none\r\n'
      b'--x\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename="a.txt"\r\n'
      b'Content-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\nhello\r\n--x--\r\n')
z=parse_multipart({'CONTENT_TYPE':'multipart/form-data; boundary=x','CONTENT_LENGTH':len(body),'rook.input':I(body)})
z['f'][0]['datapath']='FILE'
print(z)
